post.summary: Accept a proposal as a new config version
post.description:
Turn the stored proposal into a **new immutable version** (D3).

This is the only path from proposal to library: nothing is ever applied
automatically, and no saved plan is mutated.

post.summary: Evaluate post-renovation follow-up for a new snapshot
post.description:
Build the deterministic follow-up summary and return an LLM/fallback verdict.

Uses the two newest MRD snapshots (``source="snapshots"``). When fewer than
two are available the synthetic provider takes over, seeded from the
configuration's plan hash so the evaluation stays reproducible.

post.summary: Stage a simulated MRD snapshot arrival
post.description:
Write one derived snapshot into the watched folder and let the watcher act.

This endpoint deliberately does **not** run the scoring itself: the point is
to reproduce the real sequence (a file lands -> the watcher notices -> the
production configuration is scored and analysed), so what is demonstrated is
the actual production path and not a shortcut. It writes into ``data/``, so
it is refused unless ``MOCK__ENABLED`` is on.

Most of the simulated renovations are taken from the shortlist of the last
recorded run: field acts on the list we published, and without that link the
coverage and lift metrics of the next cycle would have nothing to grade.

SaveScoringRequest.title: SaveScoringRequest
SaveScoringRequest.description:
Body accepted by ``POST /api/scorings`` — persist a configuration version.

Supplying ``config_id`` appends a new **version** to that lineage; omitting
it starts a new lineage at version 1. Saved versions are never edited (D3).

SimulatedSnapshot.title: SimulatedSnapshot
SimulatedSnapshot.description:
Body returned by ``POST /api/snapshots/simulate``.

Describes the snapshot file that was just staged in the watched folder, and
whether the watcher is on to pick it up (if it is off, nothing will run).
